detailed_description: Mortgage Calculator is a comprehensive home loan tool that helps you calculate monthly payments, total interest, and view detailed amortization schedules. Enter home price, down payment, interest rate, and loan term to get instant results. Support for extra payments to see how you can pay off your mortgage faster.
usage_steps: View monthly payment and amortization schedule
usage_examples: Calculate monthly payments for a $300,000 home
See how extra payments reduce total interest
